globalNews.title: Audio reveals exchanges between Spain train operators and drivers moments before deadly crash
globalNews.summary: The leaked tapes appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move at normal speed, even though another up ahead had stalled.

globalNews.title: Russian drone attack on Ukrainian train station kills at least 14, officials say
globalNews.summary: At least 14 others were wounded in the attack in the central city of Dnipro, including an 11-year-old boy.

globalNews.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
globalNews.summary: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

globalNews.title: Philippine police obtain warrant to search Thomas Markle's devices
globalNews.summary: Images of child sexual abuse allegedly belonging to Meghan's father had reportedly been found in his former home in the Philippines.

globalNews.title: Rock collapse kills two in Turkey's Cappadocia, local media reports
globalNews.summary: One of the region's famous rock formations, known as "fairy chimneys", reportedly collapsed outside an open-air museum.

cryptoNews.title: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
cryptoNews.summary: Hyperliquid’s token pumped following news of ICE and Trade[XYZ] unveiling plans for US perpetual futures.

cryptoNews.title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
cryptoNews.summary: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.

cryptoNews.title: Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
cryptoNews.summary: The tokenized shares would carry the same shareholder rights as traditional stock, with round-the-clock trading and immediate settlement under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

cryptoNews.title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
cryptoNews.summary: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.

cryptoNews.title: Bitcoin price jumps to $81.5K as US GDP data beats expectations
cryptoNews.summary: BTC price action returned to a key weekly resistance level as US stock markets digested Alphabet’s Q3 earnings miss.

aiNews.title: Granola crunches up a dictation feature to compete with Wispr
aiNews.summary: Uno reverse! After Wispr added meeting notes to its dictation app, Granola is adding dictation to its meeting notetaker. The voice AI wars are getting interesting.

aiNews.title: Mistral releases weights for its trillion-parameter AI model, targeting cybersecurity
aiNews.summary: Mistral says its new model can afford organizations a kind of control over its cyber defenses that closed models can't.

aiNews.title: US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
aiNews.summary: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
